notes: 16 concerns judged (C3-C8, C13-C15, C18-C21, C23-C25); C1, C2, C9-C12, C16, C17, C22, C26, C27 excluded by category. All fixed_in_v1 false: the referee file states v1 is the first-submitted manuscript with no round-1 revisions, and the paper still gives M_t = 1.2, M_b = 0.6 without units; C24 concerns Fig. S8, which is in the SI absent from v1, so neither review could have raised it. A raised 4 (C3, C5, C8, C19) and partly 7; B raised 1 (C19) and partly 1 (C5). Review B explicitly limited itself to its lookalike library plus three added mechanisms, so it never engages the theory/simulation concerns. A's novelty point (Refs. 33-35, 43) matches excluded C1 and its P-breaking remark matches excluded C9, so neither is listed as extra. C21 'partly' for A is generous: A points to the same panels (2a, 2f) at low field but frames it as a C2z-relation failure, not the qualitative near-zero-field difference. Both reviews share the self-gating and Joule-heating alternatives, which no referee raised.
